2.175.22
LinearScale.ToolTip
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The LinearScale.ToolTip element specifies the tooltip text for a LinearScale. The element can also be
used to render alternative text (alt text) that is specified as an alt attribute in an HTML report. The
LinearScale.ToolTip element is optional. The value of this element MUST be a String
([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String.
The following is the parent element of the LinearScale.ToolTip element.
Parent elements
LinearScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the LinearScale.ToolTip element.
 <xsd:element name="ToolTip" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
